SurveyResponse.title: SurveyResponse
SurveyResponse.description: Represents a single submission from the student transport experience survey.

submittedAt.description: The timestamp when the survey was submitted.

commuteMethod.description: Primary method of commuting to and from campus.

commuteDays.description: Number of days per week the user commutes.

leaveTime.description: Typical time the user leaves campus.

overcrowdingFrequency.description: How often the user experiences overcrowded vehicles.

boardingStress.description: Stress level associated with boarding transport.

useApp.description: Likelihood of using a smart transit mobile app.

seatAvailabilityImportance.description: Importance of knowing seat availability beforehand.

features.description: Most desired features in a transit app.

musicAppeal.description: Appeal of having music during trips.

suggestMusic.description: Interest in suggesting music during trips.

useWallet.description: Willingness to use a prepaid wallet for payments.

payForSeat.description: Willingness to pay more for a guaranteed seat.

joinPilot.description: Interest in joining the pilot program.

earlyAccess.description: Interest in early access to the app.

recommend.description: Likelihood of recommending the service to others.

TelemetryData.title: TelemetryData
TelemetryData.description: Represents anonymous telemetry data captured from website traffic.

id.description: Unique identifier for the telemetry data record.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the telemetry data was recorded.

pageView.description: The URL or route of the page visited.

userAgent.description: User agent string of the browser used.

ipAddress.description: IP address of the user (anonymized for privacy).

deviceType.description: Type of device used (e.g., desktop, mobile, tablet).

operatingSystem.description: Operating system used (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, Android).

location.description: Geographic location based on IP address (coarse-grained).

ContactFormSubmission.title: ContactFormSubmission
ContactFormSubmission.description: Represents data submitted through the contact form.

id.description: Unique identifier for the contact form submission.

submissionDate.description: Date and time the form was submitted.

name.description: Name of the person submitting the form.

email.description: Email address of the person submitting the form.

message.description: The message content from the contact form.

DriverApplication.title: DriverApplication
DriverApplication.description: Represents a driver application submitted through the driver recruitment page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the driver application.

applicationDate.description: Date and time the application was submitted.

/survey-responses/{responseId}.description: Stores individual responses from the student transport survey.

/telemetry_data/{telemetryId}.description: Stores website telemetry data. No denormalized authorization fields are needed as access is likely public write.

/contact_form_submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores contact form submissions. No denormalized authorization fields are needed as access is likely public write.

/driver_applications/{applicationId}.description: Stores driver applications. No denormalized authorization fields are needed as access is likely public write.
